mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 11 degrees now, clear sky. Next 24 hours: high 12, low 4.

Vinicius Junior has confirmed he lost his place in Real Madrid's starting lineup after the team's strong performances in matches he missed, according to Spain's Diario AS.

Jean-Luc Mélenchon, the radical left candidate for France's presidency, has added a gradual withdrawal from NATO to his official program, alongside plans to nationalise several major companies.

Kosovo's health minister Armend Zemaj has challenged Prime Minister Albin Kurti's claim that 171 doctors from the diaspora will return, demanding a list of at least 17 names instead of the vague figure.

Police in Pristina have arrested a suspect believed to be involved in roughly 14 serious thefts, saying the arrests were part of a broader crackdown on organized burglary.

Large piles of waste have built up on Lord Bajron Street in the Aktash neighbourhood of Pristina, creating severe inconvenience for residents, officials reported.
